sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च । मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ॥
hindiTranslation: इसलिये तू सब समयमें मेरा स्मरण कर और युद्ध भी कर ।  मेरेमें मन और बुद्धि अर्पित करनेवाला तू निःसन्देह मेरेको ही प्राप्त होगा ॥
englishTranslation: Therefore, remember Me at all times and fight. With mind and intellect offered to Me, you will surely come to Me.
essence: Action and remembrance can happen together without conflict.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Keep the divine in mind all the time, do your duty, and place your thoughts and understanding there. Then you will surely reach the divine.
simpleInsight: You do not have to choose between devotion and action. Both can live in the same moment.
detailedMeaning: Krishna has already taught that the final thought shapes the final destination. Now he goes further: remembrance and action can go together, and a warrior can fight while keeping inward devotion.
modernRelevance: A nurse on a twelve-hour night duty keeps her mother's prayer going under her breath while changing dressings and calming patients. Krishna asks Arjuna for that pairing: do the hard work in front of you with the mind resting on him.
translationLiteral: तस्मात् (therefore) / सर्वेषु कालेषु (at all times) / माम् (Me) / अनुस्मर (remember continuously) / युध्य (fight) / च (and) / मयि (in Me) / अर्पित (offered) / मनः (mind) / बुद्धिः (intellect) / माम् (Me) / एव (indeed) / एष्यसि (you will come) / असंशयम् (without doubt)
insight: Krishna gives Arjuna two orders together: remember me at all times, and fight.

quoteVariants.text: Remember the divine at all times. Fight with your whole mind offered.
Remember. Act. Offer mind and intellect.
Stay with the divine, even while you fight.
Remember the divine. Act without splitting.
